authority: User-confirmed project rules; newer user instructions take precedence
title_character_count: Unicode code points after NFC normalization; record actual count, no forced filler
unverified_claim_examples: mọi phim kim loại gây phản chiếu taplo/chói mắt

sequence: Read media and identify vehicle/product/category/main need
Search public YouTube/web and inspect relevant video metadata
Use available search queries only from verified exact channel Analytics
Select relevant keyword set and usually6–10hashtags if justified
Remove excessive semantic duplicates,wrong products,unmentioned locations,generic trends
Review title,description,tags as well as hashtags
keyword_research.research_failure: Continue with verified video facts; record tool/source limitations; ask only if essential information is missing

description_editing.voice: Vietnamese, direct, natural automotive installer introduction, easy for car owners
description_editing.opening: Exact vehicle/product/upgrade and useful viewing value in first two lines
avoid_report_phrases: cấu hình sản phẩm được giới thiệu
được trình bày để tham khảo
answer_inline: product reference price scope and completed-vehicle quote
description_editing.preserve_verified_conditions: Technical/warranty conditions stay public when relevant; tax and full commercial data stay internal under public_commercial.
description_editing.limits: One short limitation next to its claim when needed; no mandatory lux/power/measurement disclaimer unrelated to claim
description_editing.ai_search: Clear entities, units, scope, contextual answers and relevant source URLs; no promised indexing/ranking/citation
description_editing.local_search: Only verified actual facility/location, no place-name stuffing
before_handoff_questions: Immediately clear what this video covers?
Anything that does not help carowner?
Important facts and conditions still complete?
Did shortening remove a useful explanation actually present in the video?
Are feature-use meanings grounded in video/source rather than inferred from watts/Kelvin?
Does the depth match this format and clip content without filler?
description_editing.remote_scope: Latest user task controls permission; draft-only request forbids remote edits even if this video was previously authorized for publication.
description_editing.avoid_default_opening: Cùng xem… trước khi chọn cấu hình
description_editing.avoid_repetitive_audience_address: Do not repeat các anh across paragraphs
description_editing.concise_definition: Remove filler and repeated ideas; preserve useful explanations and enough consultation context.
description_editing.long_form: Expand supported problem/need, notable points, feature-use meaning, choice/installation advice, optional price/warranty, CTA; choose sections that actually exist in the clip.
description_editing.shorts: Short according to actual content; no forced long-form narrative or uniform length.
description_editing.gem_style: Retain problem explanation and owner-question answers; remove clichés, repetition and unsupported claims. Do not claim to have read an unavailable original Gem.
description_editing.ai_search_depth: Clear answers with sufficient context and consistent facts; no keyword padding or citation/ranking promises.

public_commercial.lighting_price_pattern: Giá bộ đèn tham khảo: {amount_vnd} đồng/{unit}. Liên hệ Auto365 để được tư vấn cấu hình và báo giá hoàn thiện theo xe.
public_commercial.warranty: Short verified duration and conditions; no invented terms

description_sections.opening_guidance: Usually first1–2lines name subject and viewing value; no fixed opening length across formats.

runtime_paths.workspace_from: --workspace or cwd ancestors with rules marker

thumbnail.source: Matching supplied thumbnail or real frames from the current video

remote_verification.compare_exact_approved_revision: Normalize CRLF/LF and trailing newline only; no silent wording/symbol changes
remote_verification.unexpected_changes: Inspect before saving; newest user instruction controls content
